deviations.what: Terracotta accent color darkened from original #E07A5F to #B54A32 to meet WCAG contrast requirements for normal text and buttons (white on #B54A32 gives 4.65:1).
deviations.why: Original #E07A5F with white text had contrast ~2.96:1, failing 4.5:1. Minimum correction applied.

deviations.what: Original sections 'Catering Cart Rental', 'Seasonal Limited Editions', 'Loyalty Stamp Card', and footer 'Company/Press' links omitted.
deviations.why: No real business data for catering, loyalty program, seasonal tabs, or company pages. Omitting per truth contract to avoid fake content.

deviations.what: Flavor card swatches use a single terracotta gradient instead of varied pastel colors.
deviations.why: Only Vitrina spine roles allowed for colors; no color variation possible without hardcoded hex outside root.

notes: CSS implements original visual identity: warm cream background, navy sidebar/footer, terracotta accents, serif headings, marquee cards, builder steps with circular numbers, and decorative scoops. Responsive off-canvas sidebar via checkbox hack. Reduced motion respects user preference.
